part.text:
Done. `npm run dev` to run it.

- `/` — currently reading + finished lists, links to each book
- `/books/new` — add-book form (title, author, status, notes)
- `/books/<id>` — detail page with notes editing, "mark as finished", and the shareable link shown on the page
- Data lives in `data/books.json` via `lib/books.js:1`; all writes are server actions in `lib/actions.js:1`

Build passes; I verified add, mark-finished, notes-save, and persistence across a server restart. Seeded with two sample books you can edit or delete from the file.
